about: Layer 1 redaction rules for twin-bridge captures (docs/CAPTURE.md section 5). Every entry has a 'why'. Values are replaced by a placeholder of the same length; names, keys and structure stay. Shape-only fields such as __rev, __req, __s, __hsi, __dyn, __csr, __user are deliberately absent. Key names match case-insensitively and exactly, so camel-case spellings need their own entry (csrftoken already covers csrfToken, sessionKey covers sessionkey).

headers.name: cookie
headers.why: Request cookies carry the login session (c_user, xs, datr, fr ...). Names stay, every value is replaced.

headers.name: set-cookie
headers.why: Cookies the server sets. Name and attributes (Path, Domain, Expires, Max-Age, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite) stay, the value is replaced.

headers.name: x-fb-lsd
headers.why: Carries the lsd anti-forgery token on GraphQL requests.

headers.name: x-fb-dtsg
headers.why: Would carry fb_dtsg if sent as a header.

keys.name: fb_dtsg
keys.why: Anti-forgery token bound to the logged-in session; sent as a form field on every async POST.

keys.name: fb_dtsg_ag
keys.why: Variant of fb_dtsg used on GET requests.

keys.name: async_get_token
keys.why: Holds the fb_dtsg_ag value inside page data.

keys.name: lsd
keys.why: Anti-forgery token; also present in logged-out pages and login forms.

keys.name: jazoest
keys.why: Checksum derived from fb_dtsg or lsd. Short, so it is only redacted where it appears under its key.

keys.name: __a
keys.why: Usually '1' (shape only), but on the logged-out mobile site's /a/bz beacon it carried a long opaque value (seen in M2a); redacted until M2b shows what it is. '1' becomes '*', so the shape stays visible.

keys.name: token
keys.why: Page data stores fb_dtsg and lsd as {"token": ...} (DTSGInitialData, LSD).

keys.name: access_token
keys.why: OAuth access token.

keys.name: refresh_token
keys.why: OAuth refresh token.

keys.name: id_token
keys.why: OpenID token.

keys.name: oauth_token
keys.why: OAuth token.

keys.name: auth_token
keys.why: Generic session credential.

keys.name: session_key
keys.why: Session key.

keys.name: sessionKey
keys.why: Session key, camel case.

keys.name: session_token
keys.why: Session token.

keys.name: csrf_token
keys.why: Anti-forgery token.

keys.name: csrftoken
keys.why: Anti-forgery token.

keys.name: xsrf_token
keys.why: Anti-forgery token.

keys.name: nonce
keys.why: Login nonces are single-use credentials.

keys.name: machine_id
keys.why: Device identifier that the login flow binds to the account (same value as the datr cookie).

keys.name: pass
keys.why: Password field of the login form.

keys.name: password
keys.why: Password, in forms and in Bloks login parameters.

keys.name: encpass
keys.why: Browser-encrypted password of the login form.

keys.name: email
keys.why: Login identifier of the account.

keys.name: contact_point
keys.why: Login identifier in Bloks login parameters.

keys.name: contactpoint
keys.why: Login identifier.

keys.name: approvals_code
keys.why: Two-factor code.

keys.name: otp
keys.why: One-time code.

keys.name: accessToken
keys.why: OAuth access token, camel case. Exact-name matching on access_token would miss it.

keys.name: refreshToken
keys.why: OAuth refresh token, camel case.

keys.name: idToken
keys.why: OpenID token, camel case.

keys.name: authToken
keys.why: Generic session credential, camel case.

keys.name: oauthToken
keys.why: OAuth token, camel case.

keys.name: sessionToken
keys.why: Session token, camel case.

keys.name: xsrfToken

keys.name: csrf
keys.why: Anti-forgery token under its short name.

keys.name: xsrf
keys.why: Anti-forgery token under its short name.

keys.name: dtsg
keys.why: Short name under which page data can hold the fb_dtsg value.

keys.name: fbDtsg
keys.why: fb_dtsg, camel case.

keys.name: dtsg_ag
keys.why: fb_dtsg_ag without its prefix.

keys.name: asyncGetToken
keys.why: async_get_token, camel case.

keys.name: userAccessToken
keys.why: Graph API user token, camel case.

keys.name: user_access_token
keys.why: Graph API user token.

keys.name: pageAccessToken
keys.why: Graph API page token, camel case.

keys.name: page_access_token
keys.why: Graph API page token.

keys.name: appsecret_proof
keys.why: Graph API request signature derived from a token.

keys.name: signed_request
keys.why: Signed payload that embeds a token.

keys.name: signedRequest
keys.why: Signed payload that embeds a token, camel case.

keys.name: client_secret
keys.why: Application secret.

keys.name: clientSecret
keys.why: Application secret, camel case.

keys.name: passwd
keys.why: Password, short spelling.

keys.name: pwd
keys.why: Password, short spelling.

keys.name: loginNonce
keys.why: Login nonce, camel case.

keys.name: login_nonce
keys.why: Login nonce.

keys.name: machineId
keys.why: Device identifier bound to the login (machine_id), camel case.

keys.name: logoutToken
keys.why: Seen in the M2b opaque-value scan (desktop page data): authorizes the logout request of the session.

keys.name: logout_hash
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: hash that authorizes logout, bound to the session.

keys.name: secret
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan (desktop page data): a 32-character value under this name; treated as a credential.

keys.name: accountKey
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: 64 hex characters bound to the account.

keys.name: accountKeyV2
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: 64 hex characters bound to the account.

keys.name: userKeyBase
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: 64 hex characters bound to the user.

keys.name: ServerNonce
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: a server nonce; exact-name matching on nonce misses it.

keys.name: compat_iframe_token
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: token that authorizes an iframe of the session.

keys.name: link_react_default_hash
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: per-session hash that signs outgoing links through the link shim.

keys.name: untrusted_link_default_hash
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: per-session hash that signs outgoing links through the link shim.

keys.name: device_id
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: device identifier bound to the login, like machine_id.

keys.name: deviceId
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: device identifier bound to the login.

keys.name: e2eeDeviceID
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: messaging device identifier bound to the login.

keys.name: openDeviceID
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: device identifier bound to the login.

keys.name: x-dgw-deviceid
keys.why: Seen in the M2b scan: device identifier in the realtime gateway's WebSocket URL.

keys.name: encrypted_serialized_cat
keys.why: Seen in M2b (desktop document, MessengerWebInitData.cryptoAuthToken): a serialized crypto auth token of about 2300 characters for the messaging client.

keys.name: encrypted
keys.why: Seen in M2b (desktop document, MRequestConfig.ajaxResponseToken): encrypted half of a response-verification token whose other half is under 'secret'.

keys.name: dtsgToken
keys.why: Top-level key of /ajax/ route responses; null in every M2b recording, but named for the fb_dtsg value when the server refreshes it.

keys.name: dtsgAsyncGetToken
keys.why: Top-level key of /ajax/ route responses; null in every M2b recording, but named for the fb_dtsg_ag value when the server refreshes it.

keys.name: cryptoAuthToken
keys.why: Messaging crypto auth token, if it is ever sent as a string.

keys.name: data
keys.why: Seen in M2b: anonymous credentials issued to the messaging web worker (MessagingWebACSGraphQLServerProviderTokenIssuanceQuery, credentials[].evaluation/proof[].data, 144 characters). Only string values are replaced; GraphQL's data object is never a string, so response structure is unaffected. 37 string values under this key in the four logged-in recordings.
